payload.title: A Papyrus deployment needs no hand-made cloud resources
payload.description: Ryan's rule (2026-11-11): nobody creates a cloud resource by hand. Every resource is defined in Git and applied by a pipeline on merge; agents read with the AWS CLI and never create or change. Person-only steps: the one seed apply, registrar name servers, the Google OAuth client, and secret values (CloudFormation cannot create SecureString parameters). Humorus issue: HUM-be87f4 (design draft in its comments). Must not regress the running Anthus deployments: the papyrus-pipeline-approver stack, the AWS_ACCOUNT_ID variable and the role-change approval workflow keep working. New pieces are additive: infra/account/ (account baseline and account stack templates), stack_deploy.py with --config, CloudFormation IMPORT, the reusable workflow account-stacks.yml.
